name: Curtains' Call
oracle_text:
Undaunted (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each opponent.)
Destroy two target creatures.
blocked_sentences: Undaunted (This spell costs {1} less to cast for each opponent.)

needs.what: a card-level cost_reduction head that counts players rather than objects: {1} less for each opponent the caster has (e.g. {"opponents": "you"}, or a player_count head in cost_reduction_keys), read at pricing time, so a four-player pod discounts {3}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction_keys (amount, count, distinct_mana_values, energy_spent_this_turn, greatest_count, greatest_mana_value, total_mana_value, total_power) all count objects matched by a filter or a turn ledger; none counts players. `amount` is a flat number, so it would be right only at one pod size. The value leaf `player_count` exists in value_keys but cost_reduction cannot read an arbitrary value.
